title: Repealing the federal ban would leave state prohibitions in place in New South Wales, Victoria and Queensland
oneLiner: Three states have their own nuclear bans; federal repeal alone would not permit a plant in any of them.
body: New South Wales, Victoria and Queensland each prohibit nuclear power facilities under state law. A federal repeal would remove one barrier but a plant on the east coast would also need the relevant state to repeal its Act, which the Coalition's plan acknowledges it would have to urge states to do.
contextBackground: The layered bans are often lost in the federal debate. They matter for what 'repeal' actually achieves: it opens the question in Western Australia, South Australia and the territories, and hands the east coast question to state parliaments.
contextDisagreement: Not contested as fact. Supporters of repeal say removing the federal ban is the necessary first step whatever the states do; opponents say it shows how little a federal repeal would change on its own.

evidenceItems.citation: ABC News, 'Coalition vows to take a chainsaw to climate laws and offshore wind', 23 September 2026 — notes state bans would also need repeal

otherClaim.title: Australia should repeal its federal ban on nuclear power generation

claimItself.title: Australia should repeal its federal ban on nuclear power generation
claimItself.oneLiner: Whether the 1998 prohibition on nuclear power plants should be lifted. Repeal is a separate question from whether anyone would then build one.
claimItself.body: Two federal Acts prohibit the approval of a nuclear power plant anywhere in Australia. Repealing them would allow proposals to be assessed on their merits under the ordinary environmental, safety and planning regimes. Whether a plant would then be commercially viable, or built in time to matter, is argued below.

ownArguments.label: AGAINST
ownArguments.text: CSIRO's GenCost report finds firmed renewables the cheapest new-build electricity for Australia and large-scale nuclear the most expensive

ownArguments.label: AGAINST
ownArguments.text: Nuclear power cannot help with Australia's electricity prices or reliability in time to matter
